originalSourceText:
Q.7  Why  is combining LiDAR and RGB-D information useful for local cost map
       generation?

      (A)  Both sensors measure exactly the same quantity and therefore eliminate
      computation

      (B) LiDAR provides wide angular coverage while RGB-D provides depth and can
       detect low/off-plane obstacles

      (C) RGB-D replaces LiDAR for 360° scanning

      (D) LiDAR provides semantic object classes while RGB-D only measures wheel
       velocity

       Explanation: The lecture specifically contrasts LiDAR's 360° field of view and long
      range with the RGB-D camera's depth information and ability to detect low/off-plane
       obstacles.

      Refer slide8 of lecture 59: Mobile Robot Demonstration
